events.text: The gavel is still ringing when a man in a plain grey robe stands up across the hall and does not sit down again. He is looking at you, and then at the wanted poster folded in his sleeve, and then at you. "That one," he says quietly to the Pavilion guards. Forty heads turn. The doors behind you are already closing.

choices.text: Draw and cut your way to the doors

effects.log: You are on your feet before the guards are. The first lantern goes over, and the hall fills with smoke and shouting.

choices.text: Go out through the window, now

effects.log: You do not wait to find out. The window is paper and lattice, and then it is the cold night air.

choices.text: Bow politely, and walk out as if nothing were wrong

effects.log: You bow to the room as a buyer bows, and walk. Nobody quite dares stop you, and nobody hands you your lots either.

events.text: A merchant who has stared at your wanted poster on every city gate is sitting two rows behind you. You only know it when you hear his voice break: "That buyer! Look at the hands, look at the way it holds the paddle!" The auctioneer stops in the middle of a word. Somewhere a gong is struck three times, and the Pavilion guards come down the aisles with their staves crossed.

choices.text: Stand and meet the guards head on

effects.log: You throw the paddle at the first guard and go through the gap behind it. The aisles are narrow, and there are a great many staves.

choices.text: Run for the kitchens and the back stairs

effects.log: You go over a table of tea bowls and out through the kitchens, with the whole Pavilion shouting behind you.

events.text: The seal on your realm holds, but the face under the hood does not: an old constable by the pillar has hunted you for years, and knows you by the way you sit. He does not shout. He simply nods to the guards, and points.

choices.text: Fight your way out, seal and all

effects.log: You keep the seal and fight as the weakling they see, which is still more than the guards expected. Then you are moving, and so are they.

choices.text: Slip away into the crowd of buyers

effects.log: You let the crowd carry you to a side door and out. The lots you won will go to someone else.
